text: SOLUTION Well, n*%8 grows bigger and bigger as n goes to infinity. Thus, the limit is co. If you have a number and then a bigger number, squaring them or taking them to any power like 388 gives you the same relationship, the original bigger number is still the bigger number when you take powers. Hence, the claim is false. A quick look at the workbook shows we are trying to use the Alternating Series Test. However, we can't conclude anything. This test shows that a series converges if the conditions presented are satisfied, but the limit is not 0. So, we can't use this test. It can't show that a series diverges. Therefore, there is Insufficient Information to conclude anything.
